summary: Verified bug fix for 'No conversion defined for L' warning. All 4 features tested and PASSED. The hasConversionDefined() function correctly identifies when a conversion exists in the database, regardless of the multiplier value.

l_unit_no_warning.details: When 'L' is selected as quantity unit with a defined conversion (multiplier=1), NO 'No conversion defined' warning appears. Bug is FIXED.

undefined_unit_warning_logic.details: The hasConversionDefined() function (Emissions.js lines 352-368) correctly checks if a conversion exists in formula parameters, separate from the conversion factor value.

clean_unit_symbols_in_dropdown.details: Unit conversion dropdown in Formula Parameters shows clean symbols only (g, kg, L, t, mL, kL, m³, cm3) - NOT 'g (Gram)' format.

conversion_formula_display.details: Conversion formula display shows correct format: 'g × 1000 →', 'L × 1 →', etc. Example text shows '1 g × 1000 = 1 kg (gram to kilogram conversion)'.

critical_code_review_comments: Good: hasConversionDefined() function (lines 352-368) properly checks for conversion existence in database, not just multiplier value
Good: conversionInfo.hasConversion (line 603-619) correctly passes the hasConversion flag to the UI
Good: Warning condition (line 1472) checks !hasConversion AND selectedUnit !== 'kg' - correct logic
Good: Formulas.js unit dropdowns (lines 939-968) use clean symbols from centralized units API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'No conversion defined for L' warning is verified. The L conversion exists in quantity_fuel parameter with multiplier=1. All tests passed.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: User reported 'No conversion defined for L' warning even though L conversion was defined with multiplier=1
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Previous logic checked if conversionFactor === 1 to show warning, but L has a valid conversion with multiplier=1
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added separate hasConversionDefined() function that checks if conversion EXISTS in database, not just if factor equals 1
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - No warning appears for L when conversion is defined
